content.short: Reddio provides easy-to-use layer 2 zkRollup APIs for scalable Ethereum apps.
content.description: Reddio enables developers to leverage Ethereum's security and stability while gaining greater scalability and lower gas costs. Through its APIs, teams can deploy on zkRollup without any smart-contract knowledge, empowering an in-app or in-game NFT marketplace and scalable asset trading. Minting NFTs is possible with JavaScript and Unity SDKs at zero gas fees, and you can build a decentralized trading platform capable of handling up to 10k TPS with minimal trading fees, helping apps scale securely.
content.meta: Reddio offers zkRollup APIs that leverage Ethereum's security while boosting scalability. Discover Reddio and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
